review_notes: Corrected: *among* (t019) moved from περιέπεσεν to λῃσταῖς, the dative it governs, so the noun unit is *among robbers* headed on *robbers* and the verb keeps *he fell*. This aligns the verse with the chapter's other twenty supplied case prepositions and with rules 21 and 69.
plegas epithentes stays joined under rule 73 because the ASV collapses the pair into the single verb *beat*; splitting it would leave one token with no English.
The two supplied junctures *and said* and *and departed* stay folded on their finite verbs under rule 88, the expressed καί at t025 keeping its own word.
